ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 60% high-intensity white/light-grey regions and 40% low-intensity black regions across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity (black) contiguous region. Extensive high-frequency black stippling and mottling distributed across the high-intensity (white) background of both lobes. Dense dark pigmentation band along the leading edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by frequent peaks and valleys; distinct deep notches present on both the left and right lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the center toward the tips; the trailing edge follows a non-linear, undulating curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark clusters on the extreme outer tips of both lobes; several small circular light-intensity scars visible within the dark central pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal dark linear marking on the lower-left lobe; shorter horizontal linear marking on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jaggedness and irregular morphology at the fluke tips, particularly the left tip, suggesting previous physical wear or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-frequency 'salt and pepper' stippled pigmentation pattern covering the majority of the visible white surface area.
